name: Turbulence closure & flow inference with PINNs
blurb: Learning RANS closures directly from sparse data, and asking how far a learned closure can be pushed before it stops being physics.

name: Inverse problems, optimal control & adjoint methods
blurb: Controlled comparisons between classical adjoint optimization and neural approaches on PDE-constrained inverse and control problems.

name: Generative & operator learning for turbulent flows
blurb: Neural operators are fast but spectrally smooth; generative models can restore the small scales they lose.

name: Film cooling & turbine heat transfer
blurb: Vortex-dynamics analysis, modeling and optimization of gas-turbine film cooling, including data-driven closures for turbulent heat transport.

name: Others
blurb: Work that sits outside the threads above: unsteady aerodynamics in multi-stage turbomachinery, and parameterized PINNs for layered elasticity.
